heading_path: 21.34  Requirements cannot be complied with for reasonable cause
text: If: (a) under these regulations, a person is required to do an act or thing, sign a document, make a declaration or file or give to the Registrar a document or evidence; and (b) the Registrar is reasonably satisfied that the person cannot comply with the requirement; subject to any condition that the Registrar may reasonably impose, the Registrar may dispense with the requirement.
